chapter_title: Concerning the Five Releases: what they are
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Five Liberations of Wisdom from Falsity

---

**¶1:** [GAP-1] five [GAP-2] processes of liberation by which divine wisdom is rescued from [GAP-3] all the dominations and powers of falsity from evil.

---

**¶2:** The first loosening and liberation is that of [GAP-4] the celestial principle of the Divine Love, since when the inmost divine love first sent forth into combat was freed from the bondage of the dominations of falsity by the Divine Spiritual Truth, which had come [GAP-5] to rescue [GAP-6] the celestial principle, abundant wisdom and [GAP-6] abundant spiritual capacity was rescued from the entire dominion of falsity. These ascended together with the inmost celestial principle into the heavenly degrees [GAP-7] of the Divine Itself. This [GAP-8] is the first liberation.

---

**¶3:** The second liberation is that of the Divine Spiritual Truth, since when the Divine Good as generative origin and [GAP-9] the Divine Truth as formative origin together organized [GAP-10] the interior states [GAP-11] and external states of the mind — the natural planes and their ruling falsities — immeasurable wisdom was rescued from them, [GAP-12] that which the inmost celestial principle had yielded when it was consumed [GAP-13] by falsity — the wis[GAP-14]dom that had been absorbed.

---

**¶4:** [GAP-15] Three successive spiritual combats [GAP-16] unfolded [GAP-17] until the time when the Divine [GAP-18] established dominion above [GAP-19] all states throughout the organized spiritual mind.

---

**¶5:** The third redemption is that of the Thi[GAP-20]rd manifestation of Divine Truth — it [GAP-21] displayed the form of divine wisdom before the falsities of the r[GAP-22]uling power; it [GAP-23] drew forth from them [GAP-24] the captive wisdom. So this is [GAP-25] the manner in which the [GAP-26] Divine manifested its form of truth, that which [GAP-27] resides in the Third Manifestation of Divine Truth as perceived by the external mind.

---

**¶6:** The fourth liberation is that of Divine Wisdom in Its Radiance, since when It was revealed within the sphere of spiritual influence, It displayed the form of divine truth before the boundaries separating interior from exterior states, and purified [GAP-28] the wisdom that abides in the interior mind. It set in order the natural planes of the mind and all the bonds connecting spiritual states. It also loosen[GAP-29]ed wisdom beyond measure throughout the entire organized spiritual structure. It imparted [GAP-30] the call of truth and the reception of the will to the faculties of the mind; It brought forth the regenerated understanding as a new perception of truth. It as[ce]nded and came to rest within the state of peace in divine [GAP-31] wisdom.

---

**¶7:** The fifth liberation and rescue is that of the Divine Providence in its fullness, which is the call of divine truth and the reception by the will, since it also [GAP-32] draws forth the spiritual life from the [GAP-33] celestial state of the Divine, sending it into active use.

---

**¶8:** [GAP-34] The Divine Spiritual Truth [GAP-35] in its operation [GAP-36] accomplished the liberation [GAP-37] through successive degrees. The first [GAP-38] degree of the celestial principle ascended and [GAP-39] was elevated as it [GAP-40] came into interior perception — [GAP-41] into wisdom. The fourth [GAP-42] degree brought forth its own perception of truth, [GAP-43] its own wisdom. And also, the fifth [GAP-44] entered into the regenerating mind, and it set it in order, [GAP-45] impressing the form of divine wisdom upon this ultimate embodiment of the fully regenerated human being.

---

**¶9:** These five great divine capaci[GAP-46]ties were made manifest. They brought forth spiritual increase [GAP-47] and were established upon [GAP-48] the successive degrees of regeneration. The inmost celestial principle [GAP-49] — when it came toward [GAP-50] liberation from spiritual combat — set in order and organized [GAP-51] the whole of the spiritual mind, [GAP-52] even as the inmost celestial [GAP-53] principle had ordained from the beginning of its descent.

---

**¶10:** In this way [GAP-54] the five divine capacities stand together in mutual [GAP-55] operation and support.

---

**¶11:** [GAP-56] Because of the wisdom that had streamed forth from [GAP-57] the Divine through its third manifestation of truth — the Divine Emissary.

---

**¶12:** The Divine Providence of life, which is the call of truth and reception by the will, shall bring to completion [GAP-58] all things. In this final state of spiritual development, they [GAP-59] bring forth the living form of the fully regenerated being, and the Divine discerns and judges the states of spiritual li[GAP-60]fe, and sends forth [GAP-61] the divine capacities. They [GAP-62] separate themselves from the [GAP-63] dominion of falsity — that which is alive [GAP-64] by virtue of the will [GAP-65] of the Divine [GAP-66] Father, the one established in eternity, all-[GAP-67]powerful. They go forth against the enemy of all good, they [GAP-68] overcome all [GAP-69] falsities and conquer the state of the natural mind in which they had [GAP-70] labored. They shall dwell in it forever, [GAP-71] for they came forth from the Divine in the beginning, just as they shall return again to divine wisdom. They ascend to the Divine at the last.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [There are] five [releases by] which the light is saved f[rom] all [the rulers and] powers of Darkness!

[The first loo]sening and saving is that of [the] First Man, since when the First M[a]n was freed fro[m the prison of] the rulers by the Living Spirit, who had come [for the rescue] of the First Man, much light and [much] power was saved from the entire ruling-power. They ascended with the First Man to the aeons [of] greatn[ess]. This [is the first] release.

The second saving is that of the Liv[ing] Spirit, since whe[n] the Father of Life and [the] Mother of [Li]fe constructed [the heavens and the earths] and [w]orlds [of the wo]rlds, the earths and their [rulers; im]measurable light was saved f[r]om them [that of the First] Man, who w[a]s devoured [by them, the] lig[ht that had been mixed]
[ ... ... ] three wars [... ...] to the time when he [... ...] above [all of] them upon the [... ...] universe.

[The third red]emption is that of the Thi[rd Ambassador, since when he] displayed [his image, and] he [... ... the r]uling-power; he [... ... ... ...] from them [... ...] So this is [how] the [release through] his image that [dwells] in the Th[ir]d Ambassador.

[Th]e fourth s[av]ing is that of Jesus the Splendour, since whe[n he was] re[ve]aled in the zone he displayed [his im]age in front of the firmaments and purified [the light] that is above. He set in order [t]he earths and all the fastenings. He also loosen[ed the] light without measure in the entire structure. He gave [the] summons and the obedience to the elements, he formed [J]esus the Youth. He as[ce]n[d]ed and rested himself in the light [land].
The fifth release and saving is that of the great counsel, w[hich is the s]umm[ons an]d the obedience, since it also [saves] the soul from the [land] of greatness.

[And] the Living Spirit [...] as he gave [forth] the release [... ...] The first [... ... he] ascended and he [... ...] as he [... ...] wisdom [... ...] The fourth [... ...] its wisdom [...] And also, the fifth [... ...] into it, and it sets it in order [and forms] its light image in this Last Statue.

These five grea[t] powe[rs of light] were revealed. They came to a profit [... ...] they were established upon [... ...] First Man [...] when he came to/ward [the light] from the struggle. He set in order and constructed [the] universe [even as] the First M[an had purposed from] his advent.
In [t]his way [also] they st[an]d with [one another]
[This is] because of the light [th]at had rushed from [the image of] the Amba[s]sa[d]or.

The counse[l] of life, which is the [s]ummons and the obedience, will make [all things complete] In this last season they [bring forth the] life of the S[t]at[ue and] he judges the sou[ls, and he] can send [... ...] powers, they [separate] from the [... ...] it is alive [by the power] of the will [of the living] Father, the establ[ished one, the all] powerful; they g[o forth against the] enemy, they [overcome] all of them [and] conquer this land that they have [... ...] in it for ever [and ever. For t]hey came fr[om h]im in the beginning, as t[hey will r]eturn again to the light. They [as]cend to him at the la[st].

fills.explanation: Standard Kephalaia opening for a numbered teaching chapter; "There are five..." introduces the enumeration naturally.
The chapter's title and recurring vocabulary centers on "release and saving"; "releases by which" sets up the mechanism clause.
"The rulers and powers of Darkness" is the standard Manichaean formula for the dominations of falsity from evil.
The definite article before "First Man" is required by the standard Kephalaia title construction.
The Living Spirit's descent to free the First Man is the foundational Manichaean rescue narrative; "came for the rescue of" is the only logical purpose clause here.
Parallel construction "much light and much power" is standard Kephalaia amplification for the abundant spiritual capacity rescued.
"Aeons of greatness" is the standard Manichaean term for the heavenly degrees of the Divine Itself.
Closing formula paralleling the chapter's enumeration pattern: "This is the first release" concludes the paragraph on the first saving.
The definite article before "Mother of Life" is required, paralleling "the Father of Life and the Mother of Life" as the paired divine agents.

The Living Spirit's construction of "the heavens and the earths" is the foundational Manichaean cosmological act; the second "earths" later in the sentence specifies "the earths and their rulers" as a distinct sub-element, which is standard Kephalaia enumerative style.
"Worlds of the worlds" is an intensifying genitive construction (like "king of kings") standard in Coptic/Manichaean cosmological enumeration.
The light saved from the rulers was specifically that belonging to the First Man — his light that had been devoured; "that of" specifies the possessor.
The First Man was devoured "by them" (the rulers), and "the" introduces the appositional phrase about the light that was mixed — matching the spiritual reading's "consumed by falsity — the wisdom."
In Manichaean cosmology, the First Man's light was "mixed" with darkness when devoured; "light that had been mixed" is the standard technical phrase for absorbed wisdom.
The spiritual reading indicates dominion "above all states"; "above all of them" is the natural Kephalaia phrasing for universal sovereignty over the rulers.
Completes "Third Ambassador" and follows the chapter's consistent pattern ("since when") used in ¶2, ¶3, and ¶6 to introduce each divine agent's action.
Paralleling ¶6 where Jesus the Splendour "displayed his image" and then acted; the conjunction "and" connects the display to the subsequent action on the ruling-power.
"This is how" is the standard Kephalaia formula for summarizing a mechanism, corresponding to "the manner in which" in the spiritual sense.
The summary explains the mechanism of the third release — it operates "through" the Ambassador's image; "the release through his image" parallels the chapter's vocabulary of liberation.
The spiritual reading indicates the image "resides" in the Third Ambassador; "dwells" is the standard Kephalaia term for an inherent divine quality.
"Purified the light that is above" describes Jesus the Splendour purifying the wisdom in the interior heavenly zones — standard Manichaean cosmological language.
"Loosened the light without measure" completes the standard Kephalaia phrase for liberating wisdom throughout the entire cosmic structure.
The definite article before "summons" is required; "gave the summons and the obedience" is the fixed Manichaean formula for the call-and-response mechanism.
"The light land" is the standard Manichaean designation for the divine realm of peace and wisdom to which the redeemer ascends.
Consistent with the chapter's central vocabulary of "release and saving"; the fifth counsel saves the soul that originates from the divine realm, paralleling each of the other four savings.
"Land of greatness" is the standard Manichaean term for the supreme divine realm of the Father of Greatness, corresponding to the celestial state of the Divine.
The most common Kephalaia paragraph connector (Coptic ⲁⲩⲱ), linking the elaboration on the Living Spirit's operation to the preceding enumeration of the five releases.
"Gave forth the release" means accomplished or produced the liberation, matching the spiritual reading's "accomplished the liberation."
The spiritual reading says "impressing the form of divine wisdom upon" the Last Statue; "sets it in order and forms its light image" describes the dual action of ordering and imprinting.
"Powers of light" is the standard Manichaean designation for divine capacities; "These five great powers of light were revealed" identifies the five agents as luminous divine forces.
The First Man came toward "the light" from the struggle — returning from spiritual combat toward the divine realm; this is the core Manichaean narrative of the First Man's rescue.
The definite article is required before "universe" — "constructed the universe" is the standard phrase for the cosmic ordering.

The spiritual reading says "even as the inmost celestial principle had ordained from the beginning"; "even as" is the standard Kephalaia connective linking the cosmic ordering to its original divine purpose.

The spiritual reading says the celestial principle "had ordained from the beginning of its descent"; "the First Man had purposed from his advent" means he ordained this order from the start of his mission.
The connective "also" links the summary statement about the five powers standing together to the preceding narrative of their individual operations.
The spiritual reading indicates "mutual operation and support"; "they stand with one another" expresses the cooperative unity of the five divine powers.
Standard Kephalaia explanatory opening for a fragment that gives the reason ("because of the light") for the preceding statements about the five powers.

Throughout the chapter, the Third Ambassador's mechanism of liberation is his displayed "image"; the light rushed from the image of the Ambassador, consistent with the Manichaean narrative of the Ambassador's form-display.
The spiritual reading says "shall bring to completion all things"; "will make all things complete" is the standard Kephalaia eschatological formula for the final consummation of the cosmic process.
The spiritual reading says "bring forth the living form of the fully regenerated being"; "they bring forth the life of the Statue" describes manifesting the Last Statue's living form.
Completes "souls" and connects the two actions: "he judges the souls, and he can send" — matching the spiritual reading's "judges the states of spiritual life, and sends forth."
The spiritual reading says "They separate themselves from the dominion of falsity"; "they separate from" is the natural Kephalaia expression for withdrawal from darkness.
The spiritual reading says "by virtue of the will"; "alive by the power of the will" expresses the divine causation of spiritual life in Kephalaia register.
"The Living Father" is a standard Manichaean divine epithet; "the will of the living Father" identifies the supreme divine agency behind all regeneration.
The spiritual reading says "the one established in eternity, all-powerful"; completing "the established one, the all-powerful" gives the full divine epithet.
The spiritual reading says "They go forth against the enemy"; "go forth against the enemy" is the standard martial phrase for the final confrontation with the power of evil.
The spiritual reading says "they overcome all falsities"; "overcome" is the appropriate verb before "all of them" and avoids repetition with "conquer" in the next clause.
Simple conjunction connecting "overcome all of them" to "conquer this land," matching the spiritual reading's parallel "overcome all falsities and conquer."
The formulaic "for ever and ever" is standard in Coptic/Manichaean texts, and "For" introduces the causal clause explaining why they shall conquer — because they originated from the Divine.
